primitives.breakdown_regime: Upon ingestion of contradicted game IDs

primitives.name: Expected Calibration Error Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Metrics.** The same functions as every other cell on the truth surface (`@sports/prediction-engine` `brierDecomposition`, `expectedCalibrationError`; results rounded to four places by the engine): Brier, ECE on **10 equal-width probability bins**, Murphy reliability / resolution / uncertainty, and separation (mean p on wins minus mean p on losses).

primitives.assumptions: Probability bins are equally spaced and cover [0,1].
primitives.breakdown_regime: When evaluating model calibration over 10 equal-width bins
